history.headline: Durable Execution for Workflows and Agents
history.subheadline: Add reliability, visibility and automated recovery to your apps, workflows, and AI agents. Runs in the cloud or on-prem. Works with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AWS Strands, OpenAI Agents, and more.

history.headline: Durable execution, now built for agents.
history.subheadline: Durable workflows and verifiable execution — workflows are always carried to completion: agents recover without losing state. Every step is cryptographically attested. Works with any agent framework.

history.headline: APIs for building secure & reliable microservices
history.subheadline: dapr allows you to build state-of-the-art apps in half the time and never worry about missing a deadline or delivering insecure & unreliable code
